positions.name: GateAsSettledOperationalRule
positions.frame: how does a deployment gate become a settled operational rule — from incident justification to codified mandate?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: Quinton's declarative (src-1) enacts the gate as already in force with its justification closed ('that is the whole reason for the gate'), and the summary (src-2) codifies the same gate as a ratified decision with scope and owner. The conviction gradient — src-1 as a performed declarative closing the argument, src-2 as a calm catalogue of settled parameters — is a register difference within one stance, not a different position. The gate is stated as load-bearing and non-negotiable in both, justified by the same prior-incident precedent.
